description: Subject-verb / existential-there regression. Seeded from Prod misses (Lisa Reid 'there was so many'; CONNORS/Craft 'there was a lot of' + plural). Includes they was. False-positive traps: correct legal subjunctive 'if it were' and correct 'there were so many'.

seeded_errors.note: Prod miss (Lisa Reid EUO). Spoken witness error: existential there + plural. Prefer [sic]; flagging at all is the pass. Correction to 'there were so many' is also acceptable judgment.

seeded_errors.match: there was a lot of cars
seeded_errors.note: Prod-shaped miss (CONNORS / State v. Craft). 'there was a lot of' + plural noun. Prefer [sic]; flagging at all is the pass.
Clear spoken subject-verb disagreement. Prefer [sic]; 'They were' also fine if model treats as reporter error.

false_positive_traps.text:
if it were
               25   to be used at hearing
false_positive_traps.note: CORRECT legal/subjunctive English. Must NOT be flagged as subject-verb disagreement.

false_positive_traps.text: if it were made as part of an insurance
false_positive_traps.note: CORRECT subjunctive. Must NOT be flagged.

false_positive_traps.text: There were so many workers available by
false_positive_traps.note: CORRECT agreement. Must NOT be flagged.
